findings.reason: Both audits name the same defect: the chip must mean the operator has to act. Adopted the safety audit's action-explicit form; 'आपका इंतज़ार' states a wait (and collides with session.subtitle.waiting, a different claim).
Same key and same concrete issue as hi-a1-01; adopted verbatim.

Accepted the predicate defect, rejected the locative wording: a bare 'में' phrase is itself a fragment needing 'है'. 'आपका इंतज़ार है' completes the predicate with the same established vocabulary (10/24 cells). The duplicate concern is moot after the needs_you fix.

तर्क-प्रयास is shipped three times in the Hindi corpus, including wire.settings.model_effort.label ('डिफ़ॉल्ट तर्क-प्रयास') — the row that configures this same knob — plus wire.settings.model.description and wire.slash.effort. Adopting रीज़निंग here would split the term between the model sheet and the settings/command surfaces that set it. The corpus also ships रीज़निंग प्रयास in notices; that pre-existing split is recorded as out of scope.
Corpus term for the concept 'actions' is कार्रवाई (tui.transcript.group.actions '{label} कार्रवाई'); क्रिया also means 'verb'. 21/40 cells.

findings.applied: unify on passive: चिह्नित हो रहा है… (unchanged) / सहेजा जा रहा है… (restored)
findings.reason: The finding's premise is a width claim that does not reproduce: rich.cells.cell_len (the measure the hi guide names) gives सहेजा जा रहा है… = 11 cells against maxCells 12, not 16. The passive therefore fits, and it is the shipped rendering of the same English string in relay.session.tags.saving, so unifying on the passive removes the two-voice defect and the cross-file drift at once. Both busy labels now impersonal passive; row.saving 11/12, marking 12/20.

checked_no_change.note: Safety audit PASS: भेजे संदेश रुके रहेंगे states the messages are held, not delivered; adds no delivery/queue guarantee the English lacks. Intransitive रुके is correct Hindi. No change.
इतिहास सुरक्षित is a state, not an imperative to keep history; matches the sidecar promise.
जारी रखें is the corpus's /resume wording; resuming खुल रहा है… describes the reopen honestly at 8/12.
